author: Amy Lisk
text: We had a great experience! They worked around our schedule to pump our rental property. The staff were very professional, friendly, and Informative. We will continue to use them at our home. ( highly recommended).

author: Scott Barnett
text: Thompsons septic came out to pump my septic tanks and told me the mat it was in failure so he quoted me $12K!  I ended up going with another company and was only charged $3800 for everything. Thompson’s take advantage of ppl. BEWARE!!!

author: Steven McCormick
text: These guys are great. Came out the day after calling and were on time. Super friendly and showed me they did it right. Highly recommend.

author: clint davis
text: Great company. Came out same day I called. They were honest and didn’t try to up sell me.  Highly recommend.

author: Scott Baker
text: We truly appreciate the professional and respect that we received as we had our septic tank pumped today. We will definitely recommend your services out to everyone. Thanks guys for the awesome job.
